At ClinDM, we are passionate about empowering healthcare professionals and researchers with
innovative Data Management solutions. With a focus on accuracy, efficiency, and compliance, we aim
to optimize the collection, storage, and analysis of medical data to facilitate groundbreaking
discoveries and advancements in patient care.

## Find a Perfect Job Right Now

In your job search, you’re probably not new to disability job boards. They are out there, and there
are options available for searching, but now that you’ve come to **disABLEDperson.com**, you’ve
found your home for all things talent-related. We’ve been doing this since 2002, and to date we have
more than 300,000 jobs available for searching. Unlike other disability job boards, we don’t send
out spiders to aggregate job listings from other Web sites. Everything you see here was posted right
here by the employer. Every candidate you meet here came through our system, not some database that
we bought to try to give you the impression that we’re full of qualified people – we are that
already.

#### Sign up to get started

## Get started today

Searching for a job can be a process for most. That's why we want to make it as easy as possible for
you.

You can go directly to jobs and begin searching, or you can sign up for an account where you will
have access to unique features to assist you in your job search. It won't be long before you will be
looking at exciting opportunities, we wish you nothing but the best!

[Sign up now »][173]

###### How we can help you...

## Increase your opportunity for employment!


###### Blog

[A web browser]

Our employment blog!

[Read our Blog »][174]


###### Search Jobs

[A phone and tablet]

Start searching jobs now!

[Search Jobs now »][175]


###### Abilities to Careers

[A calculator]

Gain marketable skills!

[Gain skills now »][176]


###### Resources

[A globe]

Read disability resources!

[Search Resources »][177]

###### What separates our disability job board

## Our commitment to you

### Do the right thing

We’re not here to bash other disability job boards. We’re glad they exist, and we will always
support any effort to help people overcoming these daily challenges find careers in which they are
fulfilled. We are different, though, and we want everyone to be aware of that. We're committed to
helping our employers achieve compliance with relevant statutes and policies, all while doing the
right thing.

### We’re Also Doing It Right

We’re proud of our place among the disability job boards market. We attract thousands of unique
visitors to our Web site every single day, and these are people both looking for work and looking
for talent. We have a long and successful track record of helping individuals and employers find
matches, and that’s why so many of our employers keep coming back to us when it’s time for more
hiring.

### We’re Not Here for Profit

Finally, we want everyone to understand that even though we’ve earned a prominent place relative to
the rest of the disability job boards market, we’re not here to maximize our profit. In fact, we’re
not even a for-profit entity. We are a 501(c)(3) charitable organization whose mission is to reduce
the high unemployment rate of individuals and veterans with disabilities. We are here to serve, and
that’s that.

###### For Employers

## We offer employer solutions to help meet affirmative action and OFCCP compliance goals.

[Learn more now »][178]

## Find a Perfect Job Right Now

In your job search, you’re probably not new to disability job boards. They are out there, and there
are options available for searching, but now that you’ve come to **disABLEDperson.com**, you’ve
found your home for all things talent-related. We’ve been doing this since 2002, and to date we have
more than 300,000 jobs available for searching. Unlike other disability job boards, we don’t send
out spiders to aggregate job listings from other Web sites. Everything you see here was posted right
here by the employer. Every candidate you meet here came through our system, not some database that
we bought to try to give you the impression that we’re full of qualified people – we are that
already.

#### Sign up to get started

## Get started today

Searching for a job can be a process for most. That's why we want to make it as easy as possible for
you.

You can go directly to jobs and begin searching, or you can sign up for an account where you will
have access to unique features to assist you in your job search. It won't be long before you will be
looking at exciting opportunities, we wish you nothing but the best!

[Sign up now »][173]

###### How we can help you...

## Increase your opportunity for employment!


###### Blog

[A web browser]

###### Search Jobs

[A phone and tablet]

[Search Jobs now »][175]


###### Abilities to Careers

[A calculator]

Gain marketable skills!

[Gain skills now »][176]


###### Resources

[A globe]

Read disability resources!

[Search Resources »][177]

###### What separates our disability job board

## Our commitment to you

### Do the right thing

We’re not here to bash other disability job boards. We’re glad they exist, and we will always
support any effort to help people overcoming these daily challenges find careers in which they are
fulfilled. We are different, though, and we want everyone to be aware of that. We're committed to
helping our employers achieve compliance with relevant statutes and policies, all while doing the
right thing.

### We’re Also Doing It Right

We’re proud of our place among the disability job boards market. We attract thousands of unique
visitors to our Web site every single day, and these are people both looking for work and looking
for talent. We have a long and successful track record of helping individuals and employers find
matches, and that’s why so many of our employers keep coming back to us when it’s time for more
hiring.

### We’re Not Here for Profit

Finally, we want everyone to understand that even though we’ve earned a prominent place relative to
the rest of the disability job boards market, we’re not here to maximize our profit. In fact, we’re
not even a for-profit entity. We are a 501(c)(3) charitable organization whose mission is to reduce
the high unemployment rate of individuals and veterans with disabilities. We are here to serve, and
that’s that.

###### For Employers

# APAC Based Global CRO
# Driven by Science, Defined by Excellence

Emerald Clinical Trials is a global leader in clinical research, partnering with over 160 biotech
companies and 15 of the world’s top 20 pharmaceutical firms. Headquartered in Singapore, we combine
scientific excellence with operational expertise to deliver end-to-end clinical trial solutions
across all phases, offering Phase I-IV and real-world studies.

With over two decades of experience and a world-renowned focus in renal research, Emerald Clinical
has helped drive medical breakthroughs through deep scientific insight, flawless execution, and an
unwavering commitment to quality.

## More Than a CRO. Your Global Scientific Partner

With over 25 years of experience and world‑renowned renal expertise, Emerald Clinical combines deep
scientific insight with flawless execution to accelerate smarter development across renal, oncology,
cardiometabolic, and early‑phase research. From our Asia‑Pacific base, our global teams across
China, EMEA, and the Americas partner with leading investigators and KOLs to turn complex research
into real results—going beyond execution to lead studies and help deliver life‑changing therapies
worldwide.

[CLINICAL TRIALS BUILT FOR YOU][107]

## Where Expertise Meets Acceleration

From our Asia-Pacific base, we unite global teams across China, EMEA, and the Americas, partnering
with top investigators and KOL networks to drive faster, smarter development in renal, oncology,
cardiometabolic, and early-phase research.

## Your Global Partner with APAC Expertise

Headquartered in Singapore, Emerald Clinical is located across the Asia-Pacific region, Europe and
the United States of America. We also provide services in Japan, Indonesia, Sri Lanka, Thailand,
Central Eastern Europe and Latin America

Partner with a CRO that combines worldwide reach with deep Asia-Pacific expertise.

## Advancing Health Across Diverse Therapy Areas

We are a global clinical research organization that blends scientific knowledge with a human touch.
Broad perspectives and local expertise enrich our network with dedicated teams as invested in your
project’s success as you are.

[Kidney icon]

### The World Leader in Renal Research

Partner with the global experts driving meaningful progress in kidney disease treatment, clinical
practice, and policy. With an extensive site network and over 100 renal studies conducted across 70+
countries, Emerald Clinical is the CRO of choice for renal innovation worldwide.

Our scientific leadership, guided by the world’s foremost renal experts, paired with proven
operational excellence and consistently high recruitment and retention rates, accelerates your path
to approval and commercialization. With regional expertise spanning 70 countries, we deliver
globally relevant insights that move renal science forward

[Discover renal expertise][109]


### Accelerating Breakthroughs in Oncology

Accelerate recruitment, enhance patient engagement, and achieve lasting impact with a global leader
in oncology trials. With over 106,000 participants enrolled across 2,200+ sites worldwide, Emerald
Clinical delivers progress through experience, adaptability, and innovative solutions.

From Australian Early Phase to global Phase III, our oncology-specialized teams ensure scientific
integrity and operational excellence at every stage. Leveraging worldwide site relationships, KOL
collaboration, and one unified cross-functional team throughout the study, we maximize your
investment and speed the path to transformative cancer therapies.

[Advance oncology research][110]

[Heart icon]

### Driving Global Progress in Cardiovascular Health

Emerald Clinical advances global health through efficient, high-quality cardiovascular trials. With
comprehensive end-to-end services, proven expertise, and a vast clinical network, we make every
study count toward meaningful, real-world outcomes.

Our expanding cardiovascular team is dedicated to addressing the growing need for systemic
therapies. Guided by multidisciplinary clinician and researcher KOLs, and informed by deep regional
insights across global populations, we ensure every trial is designed with scientific precision and
local relevance.

[Get cardiovacular results][111]

[Explore our diverse expertise][112]

## Your Partner from Concept to Conclusion

As a full-service global clinical research organization, we support you at every step. With access
to diverse patient populations and commitment to consistent trial delivery, we keep you on the
critical path to key milestones, always prioritizing patients, data quality, and cost‑effective
solutions.

[See how we can support you][113]

### Regulatory Services

Navigate the regulatory landscape with confidence supported by our global team. By tailoring
strategies to your needs, we deliver clinical trials efficiently from start-up to safety reporting,
streamlining your path to success.

[Learn more][114]

### Clinical Monitoring & Site Management

Drive efficiency through access to unparalleled local knowledge throughout the Asia-Pacific region
and beyond. Our dedication to data integrity underpins our exceptional track record in risk-based
clinical trial monitoring, saving you time and money.

[Learn more][115]

### Program & Protocol Design

Collaborate with us to develop comprehensive trial strategies that meet regulatory and sponsor
requirements. No matter how complex your project, count on us to deliver efficient, cost-effective,
and custom programs and protocols.

[Learn more][116]

### Safety & Pharmacovigilance Services

Simplify your safety surveillance with seamless monitoring throughout the product lifecycle. Backed
by 20+ years of experience and advanced automation, we provide flexible and effective global
solutions for safety and compliance.

[Learn more][117]

## Stay Updated

The latest news, insights, and resources from our team.

[See where we’ll be next][118][See what’s new][119]

# APAC Based Global CRO
# Driven by Science, Defined by Excellence

Emerald Clinical Trials is a global leader in clinical research, partnering with over 160 biotech
companies and 15 of the world’s top 20 pharmaceutical firms. Headquartered in Singapore, we combine
scientific excellence with operational expertise to deliver end-to-end clinical trial solutions
across all phases, offering Phase I-IV and real-world studies.

With over two decades of experience and a world-renowned focus in renal research, Emerald Clinical
has helped drive medical breakthroughs through deep scientific insight, flawless execution, and an
unwavering commitment to quality.

## More Than a CRO. Your Global Scientific Partner

With over 25 years of experience and world‑renowned renal expertise, Emerald Clinical combines deep
scientific insight with flawless execution to accelerate smarter development across renal, oncology,
cardiometabolic, and early‑phase research. From our Asia‑Pacific base, our global teams across
China, EMEA, and the Americas partner with leading investigators and KOLs to turn complex research
into real results—going beyond execution to lead studies and help deliver life‑changing therapies
worldwide.

[CLINICAL TRIALS BUILT FOR YOU][107]

## Where Expertise Meets Acceleration

From our Asia-Pacific base, we unite global teams across China, EMEA, and the Americas, partnering
with top investigators and KOL networks to drive faster, smarter development in renal, oncology,
cardiometabolic, and early-phase research.

## Your Global Partner with APAC Expertise

Headquartered in Singapore, Emerald Clinical is located across the Asia-Pacific region, Europe and
the United States of America. We also provide services in Japan, Indonesia, Sri Lanka, Thailand,
Central Eastern Europe and Latin America

Partner with a CRO that combines worldwide reach with deep Asia-Pacific expertise.
With our APAC heritage and local teams across the globe, we streamline patient recruitment, navigate
diverse regulatory landscapes, and deliver reliable, high-quality results, every time.

## Advancing Health Across Diverse Therapy Areas

We are a global clinical research organization that blends scientific knowledge with a human touch.
Broad perspectives and local expertise enrich our network with dedicated teams as invested in your
project’s success as you are.

[Kidney icon]

### The World Leader in Renal Research

Partner with the global experts driving meaningful progress in kidney disease treatment, clinical
practice, and policy. With an extensive site network and over 100 renal studies conducted across 70+
countries, Emerald Clinical is the CRO of choice for renal innovation worldwide.

Our scientific leadership, guided by the world’s foremost renal experts, paired with proven
operational excellence and consistently high recruitment and retention rates, accelerates your path
to approval and commercialization. With regional expertise spanning 70 countries, we deliver
globally relevant insights that move renal science forward

[Discover renal expertise][109]


### Accelerating Breakthroughs in Oncology

Accelerate recruitment, enhance patient engagement, and achieve lasting impact with a global leader
in oncology trials. With over 106,000 participants enrolled across 2,200+ sites worldwide, Emerald
Clinical delivers progress through experience, adaptability, and innovative solutions.

From Australian Early Phase to global Phase III, our oncology-specialized teams ensure scientific
integrity and operational excellence at every stage. Leveraging worldwide site relationships, KOL
collaboration, and one unified cross-functional team throughout the study, we maximize your
investment and speed the path to transformative cancer therapies.

[Advance oncology research][110]

[Heart icon]

### Driving Global Progress in Cardiovascular Health

Emerald Clinical advances global health through efficient, high-quality cardiovascular trials. With
comprehensive end-to-end services, proven expertise, and a vast clinical network, we make every
study count toward meaningful, real-world outcomes.

Our expanding cardiovascular team is dedicated to addressing the growing need for systemic
therapies. Guided by multidisciplinary clinician and researcher KOLs, and informed by deep regional
insights across global populations, we ensure every trial is designed with scientific precision and
local relevance.

[Get cardiovacular results][111]

[Explore our diverse expertise][112]

## Your Partner from Concept to Conclusion

As a full-service global clinical research organization, we support you at every step. With access
to diverse patient populations and commitment to consistent trial delivery, we keep you on the
critical path to key milestones, always prioritizing patients, data quality, and cost‑effective
solutions.

[See how we can support you][113]

### Regulatory Services

Navigate the regulatory landscape with confidence supported by our global team. By tailoring
strategies to your needs, we deliver clinical trials efficiently from start-up to safety reporting,
streamlining your path to success.

[Learn more][114]

### Clinical Monitoring & Site Management

Drive efficiency through access to unparalleled local knowledge throughout the Asia-Pacific region
and beyond. Our dedication to data integrity underpins our exceptional track record in risk-based
clinical trial monitoring, saving you time and money.

[Learn more][115]

### Program & Protocol Design

Collaborate with us to develop comprehensive trial strategies that meet regulatory and sponsor
requirements. No matter how complex your project, count on us to deliver efficient, cost-effective,
and custom programs and protocols.

[Learn more][116]

### Safety & Pharmacovigilance Services

Simplify your safety surveillance with seamless monitoring throughout the product lifecycle. Backed
by 20+ years of experience and advanced automation, we provide flexible and effective global
solutions for safety and compliance.

#### Detailed Market Analysis

The pharmaceutical industry is undergoing a remarkable digital transformation, supported by concrete
market research and verified statistics. The scale of this transformation is evidenced by the
pharmaceutical digital platform market’s projected growth from $4.92 billion in 2023 to $34.12
billion by 2032, representing a robust CAGR of 24.35%. This growth is driven by widespread cloud
adoption, with approximately 80% of pharmaceutical companies already utilizing cloud computing
solutions and 95% expected to be fully cloud-operational within two years.

The transformation is happening across multiple dimensions, with web-based solutions dominating at
72.27% market share and AI-driven engagement representing 27.05% of patient engagement solutions.
Quality management systems are also evolving, with the market expected to grow from $1.87 billion in
2024 to $3.85 billion by 2030 at a CAGR of 12.99%. This digital evolution is particularly strong in
North America, which holds a 43.6% share in patient engagement solutions and 39% of the quality
management software market. Implementation timelines vary by solution complexity, ranging from 3-6
months for modular SaaS deployments to 9-18 months for full-suite implementations, reflecting the
industry’s methodical approach to digital adoption while maintaining compliance with regulatory
requirements.

## Explore the latest from Labcorp

### REAL-WORLD DATA PLATFORM

#### AI‑powered real‑world data platform for Alzheimer's disease

Developed with Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Datavant, Labcorp’s AI-powered platform delivers
longitudinal laboratory data at scale with advanced analytics to accelerate discovery, streamline
drug development, and improve patient outcomes.

[ Learn More ][211]
[Read Press Release][212]
[Mother and daughter embracing themselves with smiles on their faces]

### MyLabcorp mobile app

#### My results, trends, and more, all in MyLabcorp.

Staying on top of your health just got easier. MyLabcorp is our AI-powered app that helps explain
your Labcorp test results, tracks your trends over time, and lets you manage appointments and
billing, in one place.

[ Learn More ][213]
[Read Press Release][214]
[Patient using MyLabcorp application on their phone]

### Test Finder

#### Plain language, smarter support: AI that speaks clinician

Labcorp's AI-enhanced Test Finder, a first-of-its-kind conversational search tool, is now integrated
into EHRs using [Labcorp Diagnostic Assistant™][215] and available through EHR companion platform
[Labcorp Link™][216], enabling seamless and intuitive test search at the point of care. 

[ View Test Finder ][217]
[Read Press Release][218]

Genetic Insights

### Invitae joins Labcorp

Labcorp welcomes the Invitae team, scientific leaders and pioneers in the development and adoption
of genetic testing.

[ Learn More ][219]

Data Solutions

### Leading with Lab Data

Providers like Dr. Doron Schneider have the power to change lives. Our lab data has the answers to
empower them.

[ Learn More ][220]

Oncology

### Delivering insights that bring hope

Testing options like solid tissue biopsies and blood-based testing alternatives help clear the path
to better outcomes for patients. 

[ Learn More ][221]

Biopharma

### Scientifically rigorous, extensive in scale

Our global lab footprint, vast clinical data and scientific expertise help accelerate the drug
development process.

[ Learn More ][222]

### Stop wondering. Go test yourself.

Explore over 50 self-ordered lab tests and get answers about your health.

## [Electronic Lab Notebook][98]

Efficiently document experiments and share ongoing research with our data-connected ELN. This
electronic lab notebook is seamlessly integrated with samples, assay data and other registered data.

[ Explore our ELN Software ][99]

#### [Electronic Data Capture][100]

## [LabKey EDC][101]

Electronic data capture software for multisite clinical trials and studies. Seamlessly integrate and
analyze participant demographics, visit information, assay data and samples in a central repository.

[ Explore our EDC Software ][102]

#### [Scientific Data Management Software][103]

## [LabKey SDMS][104]

LabKey SDMS is highly customizable scientific data management system that supports a variety of
research protocols, analysis tools, data integrations and compliance needs. The platform also serves
as the foundation for our life science software products.

[ Explore our SDMS Software ][105]
[SDMS Software]

#### [SDMS - Scientific Data Management System][106]

## [LabKey Server SDMS][107]

Integrate, analyze, and share your life science data. LabKey Server SDMS is highly customizable for
a variety of research protocols, analysis tools, data integrations and compliance needs. The
platform also serves as the foundation for our life science software products.

[[icon download]Download Community Edition][108] [ Explore our SDMS Software ][109]

## Working with LabKey is different. We hear that’s a good thing!

LabKey is more than just another software vendor. Our life science software products have been
developed in collaboration with researchers to deliver impactful features backed by best-in-class
support. We form lasting partnerships with our clients to meet their research technology needs now,
and into the future.

### Consultative Approach

We help you realize early “wins” that lay the foundation for successful implementation and adoption
within your organization.

### Partnership for Success

Our account managers and engineering team provide hands-on support and expertise tailored to your
needs.

### Proven Track Record

We have successfully partnered with life science organizations since 2003 to deliver innovative life
science software solutions.

# THE FUTURE OF
# NERVE REPAIR

Better solutions for physicians and patients

## VISION

Developing Better Solutions For Physicians And Patients

Neuraptive is developing novel therapeutics and medical products to address the unmet needs of
physicians and patients impacted by peripheral nerve injuries.

[Illustration of the human arm anatomy representing nerves, bones and ligaments..jpg]

## RESEARCH & TECHNOLOGY

The Future of Peripheral Nerve Repair and Recovery

### PEG-FUSION 

Neuraptive has in-licensed technology from the University of Texas at Austin (UT) protecting a novel
fusion system for repairing severed peripheral nerves. This technology improves both the speed and
outcomes of peripheral nerve injuries (PNI).

[Learn More][13]
[Neuraptive Website Banner 1 Nerve Fusion.png]
[Neuraptive Website Banner 2 Drug Delivery Device.png]
[Neuraptive Website Banner 2 Drug Delivery Device.png]

### DRUG DELIVERY DEVICE

A specialized device focusing on the delivery of active agents for topical administration directly
on the nerve.

[Learn More][14]

### MICROSURGICAL INSTRUMENTS

Neuraptive is developing nerve-specific microsurgical instruments that address current product
limitations in the field of nerve repair.

[Learn More][15]
[Neuraptive Website Banner 3 Microsurgical Instruments.png]
[clinic, profession, people, healthcare and medicine concept - group of medics or doctors w]

## THE NEURAPTIVE DIFFERENCE

An innovative technology potentially revolutionizing nerve repair.

Neuraptive has developed a surgical treatment kit for peripheral nerves after traumas or peripheral
nerve reconstruction procedures.  NTX-001 leverages the 505(b)(2) development pathway (comprised of
previously approved pharmaceutical ingredients) presented in sterile solutions.

[Read More][16]
[Neuraptive Website Banner 4 By The Numbers.png]

## By The Numbers

$2.7B

U.S. MARKET

OPPORTUNITY

20M

U.S. LIVES

TO IMPACT

## INDUSTRY

### Our
### Partner

The in-licensed and issued patent estate from the University of Texas protects the method of
repairing nerves embodied in NTX-001. We have invented a novel delivery device, a formulation and a
kit design for which separate patent applications have been filed. Patent protections is expected to
extend through 2038.

[Neuraptive Partners 2.png]

UNIVERSITY OF

TEXAS AUSTIN

## INVESTORS

Want to learn about upcoming investment opportunities?

 

Contact us for investor relations information.

Contact

OPPORTUNITY

Market opportunities include acute trauma patients as well as patients undergoing corrective,
reconstructive, and elective surgeries.

 

Reimbursements for nerve repair procedures are well-established and significant. Neuraptive’s
products address a ~$2.7B US and >$5.5B global market opportunity.

[Image by Martin Woortman]

**[PharmaBharat.com ][149]**is your go-to platform for job postings, specifically tailored for
individuals with qualifications such as **B Pharm, M Pharm, D Pharm, Pharm D, MSC, BSC, PHD,

cover a wide range of positions in the **Science and IT sectors.**

## Why Should I Consider a Pharmabharat Jobs?

In the industry, there are numerous fake job portals that do not provide genuine vacancies. Here, we
ensure that we first confirm with HR before uploading any job listings for you.

## Pharma Jobs Today

**[PharmaBharat.com ][149]**is your go-to platform for job postings, specifically tailored for
individuals with qualifications such as **B Pharm, M Pharm, D Pharm, Pharm D, MSC, BSC, PHD,
Biotechnology, Microbiology, Pharmaceutics, Biochemistry**, and more. Our comprehensive job listings
cover a wide range of positions in the **Science and IT sectors.**

## Why Should I Consider a Pharmabharat Jobs?

In the industry, there are numerous fake job portals that do not provide genuine vacancies. Here, we
ensure that we first confirm with HR before uploading any job listings for you.

## What Kind of Jobs i will Get Here ?

At PharmaBharat.com, we post a variety of job types to cater to the diverse skill sets within the
pharmaceutical and biotech industries. Our job categories include:
**[Production][150]:** Explore opportunities in pharmaceutical production roles.
**[Packing][151]:** Find jobs related to packaging within the pharmaceutical sector.
**Pharmacist:** Discover openings for qualified pharmacists.
**[Research and Development][152]:** Explore roles in both Formulation and Analytical Development
**[Warehouse][153]:** Find positions related to pharmaceutical warehouse management.
**Chemistry:** Explore opportunities for chemists in the pharmaceutical field.
**[Tutor/Lecturer:][154]** Discover academic positions for teaching in pharmaceutical sciences.
**[Government Job][155]:** Explore government job opportunities in the pharmaceutical sector.
**[Scientist][156]:** Find roles for experienced scientists in various specializations.
**[Clinical Data Management][157]:** Explore positions related to the management of clinical data.
**[Medical Coding:][158]** Find jobs in medical coding within the pharmaceutical and healthcare
industries.
**[Medical Writing][159]:** Discover opportunities for professionals in medical writing.
**Medical Representative:** Explore roles in pharmaceutical sales and representation.
**Marketing and Sales:** Find positions in the marketing and sales of pharmaceutical products.
**[Quality Control (QC)][160]:** Discover opportunities in quality control within the pharmaceutical
sector.
**[Quality Assurance (QA][161]):** Explore roles related to quality assurance in pharmaceuticals.
**[DRA (Drug Regulatory Affairs)][162]:** Find positions in regulatory affairs within the
pharmaceutical industry.
**JRF (Junior Research Fellow):** Explore opportunities for junior researchers.
**SRF (Senior Research Fellow):** Discover positions for senior research fellows.

# [Phoenix CTMS][1]

The ultimative PRS/CTMS/CDMS. Integrated, web-based and free.
* [Features][2]
  * [Overview][3]
  * [Modules][4]
    * [Overview][5]

[Phoenix CTMS]

Phoenix CTMS is a modern web application combining capabilities of database software used in
clinical research in *one* modular system.
* PRS (Patient Recruitment System)
* CTMS (Clinical Trial Management System)
* CDMS (Clinical Data Management System) – EDC (Electronic Data Capture) Package

This unmatched feature set is geared to support all operational and regulatory requirements of the
clinical front end in academic research, at CROs (Contract Research Organisations) and hospitals
conducting clinical studies of any phase.

After years of collaborative development with trial sites at the [Medical University of Graz][21],
the Phoenix CTMS now becomes publicly available ([LGPL 2.1][22]). It could be the perfect choice if
you e.g.
* need a private, *encrypted* subject registry for PII (personally identifyable information), to
  complement your existing CDMS
* need a solution to comply with upcoming [EU-GDPR][23] (General Data Protection Regulation)
* want to operate a secure online *signup portal* for subject candidates
* must not store the sensitive data in the *cloud*
* are not satisfied with the edit check or form field calculation possibilities available in other
  EDC packages
* want a CDMS that gives you unlimited *Javascript* form scripting support (server- and browserside)
* need to deal with *large* eCRFs (electronic case report forms)
* want to try a serious open source alternative for eCRFs
* need to formulate complex *ad-hoc* database queries to list matching subject candidates using *set
  operations*
* conduct several trials in parallel and need to organize site staff and resources
* need a software to implement various processes for ICH GCP (good clinical practice) compliance
* want a turn-key system that’s operational out-of-the-box, instead of integrating multiple systems

[Phoenix CTMS]

Phoenix CTMS is a modern web application combining capabilities of database software used in
clinical research in *one* modular system.
* PRS (Patient Recruitment System)
* CTMS (Clinical Trial Management System)
* CDMS (Clinical Data Management System) – EDC (Electronic Data Capture) Package

This unmatched feature set is geared to support all operational and regulatory requirements of the
clinical front end in academic research, at CROs (Contract Research Organisations) and hospitals
conducting clinical studies of any phase.

After years of collaborative development with trial sites at the [Medical University of Graz][21],
the Phoenix CTMS now becomes publicly available ([LGPL 2.1][22]). It could be the perfect choice if
you e.g.
* need a private, *encrypted* subject registry for PII (personally identifyable information), to
  complement your existing CDMS
* need a solution to comply with upcoming [EU-GDPR][23] (General Data Protection Regulation)
* want to operate a secure online *signup portal* for subject candidates
* must not store the sensitive data in the *cloud*
* are not satisfied with the edit check or form field calculation possibilities available in other
  EDC packages
* want a CDMS that gives you unlimited *Javascript* form scripting support (server- and browserside)
* need to deal with *large* eCRFs (electronic case report forms)
* want to try a serious open source alternative for eCRFs
* need to formulate complex *ad-hoc* database queries to list matching subject candidates using *set
  operations*
* conduct several trials in parallel and need to organize site staff and resources
* need a software to implement various processes for ICH GCP (good clinical practice) compliance
* want a turn-key system that’s operational out-of-the-box, instead of integrating multiple systems

# About
# SCOPE

For 25 years, SCOPE has empowered pharmaceutical innovation as an **independent, full-service CRO**.
With **11 offices** across Europe, we deliver comprehensive clinical development and consulting
services focused on **cost efficiency, rapid timelines, and top-quality results**. Our established
global partnerships ensure we meet and exceed industry benchmarks, driving success in every phase of
clinical research.
‍

**Ready to accelerate your next project? Contact us today!**
[contact us][89]

Responsiveness, flexibility and outstanding service – that’s what our clients know us for.

### “Delivering outstanding service“

"Before working with SCOPE, we had partnered with several large CROs and often ran into challenges -
rigid structures, a lack of flexibility, and surprisingly, lack of experience, despite their
extensive resources. Our experience with SCOPE has been notably different. Their project leads are
determined, results-driven, and have a clear ‘get things done’ attitude. The entire team is deeply
committed. What truly sets them apart is their focus on delivering outstanding service rather than
tracking every billable hour. It’s been one of our most positive CRO collaborations to date."
Project Manager, Pharmaceutical Company

### “One of the best collaborations“

“I was skeptical at first – SCOPE had little experience in oncology. But it turned out to be one of
the best collaborations I've had in over 25 years. The team was consistent from start to finish,
with strong leadership and excellent project management – something you don’t often see with CROs.
The trial was delivered professionally and on time. I now recommend SCOPE with confidence.”
CEO, Pharmac

## A Specialized CRO Combining Clinical Expertise and Technology Innovation

SDC is a technology-enabled CRO delivering comprehensive clinical trial services with integrated
solutions across eSource, ePRO, EDC, IRT, and AI-powered analytics.

Powered by our AI-enabled SDC DataHub, we centralize and harmonize clinical data, ensuring accurate,
real-time reporting across all systems.

Whether Centralized, Decentralized, or Hybrid, SDC solutions are built for flexibility, scalability,
and compliance.

[Learn More][24]

\

#### SDC DataHub - AI-enabled data lake for clinical trial management that is the next generation
#### backbone for a Clinical drug development ecosystem.

**[Learn More][25]**

#### what is happening in their trials independent of the system, all in one place.

#### **Delivering Solutions That Drive Healthcare Forward**

## About Us

Founded in 1996 as the SIRO Research Foundation and incorporated in 2000 as SIRO Clinpharm Private
Limited, SIRO brings over two decades of exceptional project management expertise to the table. From
pioneering proof-of-concept trials to managing complex, multinational studies involving rare
diseases, stringent protocols, and accelerated timelines, SIRO has consistently delivered with
precision and reliability. Our win-win philosophy drives us to ensure success for every client.
Today, SIRO stands as a leading provider of drug development and discovery solutions, offering a
diverse and innovative suite of CRO services to global biotech, pharmaceutical, medical device, and
academic institutions. To better serve our clients’ evolving needs, we have strategically
reorganized into three specialized verticals: SIRO Clintech, SIRO Medical Writing, and SIRO
Clinpharm, which continues to offer specialized FSP services.

SIRO Group encompasses three distinct companies, each specializing in unique sectors to provide
comprehensive solutions.

Best-in-class medical writing services, supporting your drug development journey from initial
regulatory filings and safety reports to impactful scientific publications. Our expertise spans the
entire value chain.

* Unmatched access to top-tier talent across the globe.
* Reliable and proven recruitment processes, ensuring consistent results.
* Global reach, connecting you with the best talent worldwide.

### Global and Experienced CRO Partnership
* We offer deep functional expertise spanning all phases of clinical development.
* Tailored and flexible solutions designed to precisely address your unique requirements.
* Our dedicated, in-house Quality Management System for FSP ensures resource skillsets and
  experience align perfectly with your job descriptions.

## Various Models in FSP Services

### Staff Augmentation

### Staff Augmentation
* Deploy on-site or remote resources as needed.
* Quickly fill resource gaps for short- or medium-term projects without long-term commitments.
* SIRO staff operate under the client’s direct supervision, ensuring alignment with project goals
  and workflows.
* The client retains full project control while leveraging SIRO’s expertise.
* SIRO resources seamlessly align with the client’s SOPs, processes, and environment.
* Dedicated resources ensure consistency, reliability, and seamless team integration.
* Cost-effective, FTE-based model optimized for efficiency.

### FSP Managed Staffing
* SIRO provides functional oversight, reducing the client’s management burden while ensuring
  efficiency.
* Direct line management is handled by SIRO, streamlining supervision and performance.
* SIRO manages hiring and line management, with resources working from SIRO offices while
  integrating into client’s tools and systems.
* The client retains project oversight, maintaining high-level control and leadership.
* FTE-based delivery model ensures consistent and cost-effective staffing.

### Hybrid Model

### Hybrid Model
* Leverage industry-leading CRO processes, tools, and systems for enhanced efficiency.
* Gain access to full-service, non-dedicated expertise tailored to project needs.
* Flexibility to operate under SIRO or client SOPs, procedures, and standards.
* A powerful blend of FTE and FSO models, offering a highly flexible and customizable approach.

## Key Differentiators of Our FSP Models

Industry-Wide Expertise
Tailored workforce solutions across pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, CROs, IT, and agencies.
Global Reach
Hiring and employment across 150+ countries through established partnerships.
Specialized Talent Access
Providing niche and hard-to-find expertise for critical roles.
Two-pronged approach to staffing
Combining internal talent pools and custom recruitment for precise hiring.
Fast & Reliable Deployment
Ensuring on-time resource delivery to minimize downtime.

…the research publications of the Gamaleya Institute support the data of the Russian Direct

Infectious Disease Specialist, Epidemiologist, Master in Public Health, and Professor at the
National University of Córdoba

So, having 2 different types of viral vectors allows of immunizing people more strongly. Now, the
world started working to see if one could combine the second dose of one brand with the first one of

vaccine is one of a number of approved vaccines made available free of charge to citizens and
residents in the Kingdom.

stands at 91.4%, while the vaccine prevents 100% of severe cases. From the first days of the
pandemic, Russia and the UAE have emphasized the importance of joint efforts to prevent the
coronavirus from spreading.

Member of the National Assembly of Hungary

The results of all the tests will be announced. However, according to the data available today, the
vaccination results (in case of some vaccines — in the amount of over half a million doses, and in
case of others — in the amount of one million doses) show that the Sinopharm vaccine is better than
Pfizer, but Sputnik is the best of all.

Minister of Economics

vaccines against corona. Naturally, Sputnik V must be approved in the European Union.

we are already protecting a large part of our population with excellent results. It will be a great
opportunity to advance in the fight against the pandemic not only in Argentina, but also in Latin
America.

International Vaccine Access Center, Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health, USA

Dr. Tom Inglesby
Director of the Center for Health Security of the Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health

The two studies by Logunov and colleagues have several strengths. First, adenoviruses are
ubiquitous, so humans might not be immunologically naive. A second strength is the threshold for
neutralisation used in the two studies. A third strength is that the vaccine, similar to other
before it, induced broad immune responses. Although not specifically discussed, the results imply a
T-helper1-cell-weighted response that might be important for vaccine safety, potentially reducing
the risk of antibodydependent enhanced disease. A fourth strength was development of two vaccine
formulations, frozen and lyophilised. A lyophilised formulation could mean stability within the
existing global vaccine refrigerated cold chain that is needed to maintain vaccine efficacy from
factory to recipient, a hurdle other vaccines are yet to address. Although more costly to produce at
scale, product stability will maximise reach in remote terrain, a must if universal and equitable
coverage is to be achieved.


Prof Nadey Hakim
Vice President of the British Red Cross, Vice President of the International Medical Sciences
Academy

The results of clinical trials of the Russian vaccine Sputnik V have demonstrated impressive
results, which have now been recognized by the international medical community. The vaccine has been
shown to be safe and effective with no serious side effects identified and uses a proven platform
based on human adenoviral vectors, which is currently the safest mechanism for introducing the
genetic code of the virus spike into the human body. This approach has been thoroughly studied not
only in Russia but also internationally. Russia has a long and successful track record developing
vaccines and remains a global leader in this field. We hope that the vaccine will soon become
available across the world to help stop the devastating pandemic and enable people to return to
normal life.


Dr Muhammad Munir
Lecturer in Molecular Virology at the Lancaster University

There are features that make Sputnik V a promising candidate. The idea of using two different
adenoviruses as vector is superior over many vaccines in the frontline. Generally, the immune system
perceive the vector proteins as antigen similar to the S protein of SARS-CoV-2, so it elicit immune
response against those proteins as well. If people are reimmunized (as second dose or repeated
vaccine), the pre-existing immunity can compromise the efficacy of second vaccine dose. Using a
vector of different nature, as is the in Sputnik V, will avoid this problem.


Prof Brendan Wren
Professor of Microbial Pathogenesis, London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine

The data on the Russian vaccine studies reported in the Lancet are encouraging - demonstrating the
safety and immunogenicity of the adenovirus-based COVID-19 vaccines.


Polina Stepensky
Chair of the Bone Marrow Transplantation and Cancer Immunotherapy Department at Hadassah hospital,
Israel

First I should say to Russian scientists and Russian health professionals is ‘Bravo!’. This
technology and scientific approach we perfectly understand and absolutely approve. You have made a
real breakthrough in science and in medicine. We are really grateful that you have done a wonderful
job. It is remarkable that stable humoral as well as cell-mediated immune response is generated.
This is achieved through the use of two different vectors delivering the drug and, at the same time,
solving the problem of a possible neutralizing effect on the second injection. The very high
efficiency of two selected adenoviruses has been proven. Thus, the platform used by the Gamaleya
Institute is the correct platform.

So, having 2 different types of viral vectors allows of immunizing people more strongly. Now, the
world started working to see if one could combine the second dose of one brand with the first one of

stands at 91.4%, while the vaccine prevents 100% of severe cases. From the first days of the
pandemic, Russia and the UAE have emphasized the importance of joint efforts to prevent the
coronavirus from spreading.

Member of the National Assembly of Hungary

The results of all the tests will be announced. However, according to the data available today, the
vaccination results (in case of some vaccines — in the amount of over half a million doses, and in
case of others — in the amount of one million doses) show that the Sinopharm vaccine is better than
Pfizer, but Sputnik is the best of all.

The two studies by Logunov and colleagues have several strengths. First, adenoviruses are
ubiquitous, so humans might not be immunologically naive. A second strength is the threshold for
neutralisation used in the two studies. A third strength is that the vaccine, similar to other
before it, induced broad immune responses. Although not specifically discussed, the results imply a
T-helper1-cell-weighted response that might be important for vaccine safety, potentially reducing
the risk of antibodydependent enhanced disease. A fourth strength was development of two vaccine
formulations, frozen and lyophilised. A lyophilised formulation could mean stability within the
existing global vaccine refrigerated cold chain that is needed to maintain vaccine efficacy from
factory to recipient, a hurdle other vaccines are yet to address. Although more costly to produce at
scale, product stability will maximise reach in remote terrain, a must if universal and equitable
coverage is to be achieved.

Vice President of the British Red Cross, Vice President of the International Medical Sciences
Academy

results, which have now been recognized by the international medical community. The vaccine has been
shown to be safe and effective with no serious side effects identified and uses a proven platform
based on human adenoviral vectors, which is currently the safest mechanism for introducing the
genetic code of the virus spike into the human body. This approach has been thoroughly studied not
only in Russia but also internationally. Russia has a long and successful track record developing
vaccines and remains a global leader in this field. We hope that the vaccine will soon become
available across the world to help stop the devastating pandemic and enable people to return to
normal life.

adenoviruses as vector is superior over many vaccines in the frontline. Generally, the immune system

vaccine), the pre-existing immunity can compromise the efficacy of second vaccine dose. Using a
vector of different nature, as is the in Sputnik V, will avoid this problem.


Prof Brendan Wren
Professor of Microbial Pathogenesis, London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine

The data on the Russian vaccine studies reported in the Lancet are encouraging - demonstrating the
safety and immunogenicity of the adenovirus-based COVID-19 vaccines.


Polina Stepensky
Chair of the Bone Marrow Transplantation and Cancer Immunotherapy Department at Hadassah hospital,
Israel

First I should say to Russian scientists and Russian health professionals is ‘Bravo!’. This
technology and scientific approach we perfectly understand and absolutely approve. You have made a
real breakthrough in science and in medicine. We are really grateful that you have done a wonderful
job. It is remarkable that stable humoral as well as cell-mediated immune response is generated.
This is achieved through the use of two different vectors delivering the drug and, at the same time,
solving the problem of a possible neutralizing effect on the second injection. The very high
efficiency of two selected adenoviruses has been proven. Thus, the platform used by the Gamaleya

**Telegram** is so simple you already know how to use it.

**Telegram** lets you access your chats from multiple devices.

**Telegram** delivers messages faster than any other application.

**Telegram** has no limits on the size of your media and chats.

**Telegram** keeps your messages safe from hacker attacks.

**Telegram** groups can hold up to 200,000 members.

**Telegram** lets you completely customize your messenger.

# Timeline maker for projects and stories

Timetoast is a free online timeline maker for work, school, and personal use. Plan projects, teach
lessons, map life events, and share interactive timelines that are easy to follow.

Used by **millions worldwide** for product launches, roadmaps, lessons, biographies, and historical
overviews.

[Create a timeline][24]
[Screenshot of Timetoast showing a color-coded timeline alongside a connected grid view for managing
timeline details.]
Popular ways to use Timetoast:
[Plan a project timeline][25] [Build a product roadmap][26] [Create a history timeline][27] [Make a
classroom timeline][28] [Create a biography timeline][29] [Prepare for a legal case][30] [Group
timeline events into lanes][31] [Switch between timeline views][32]

## Project timeline example

Loading example...

## A timeline maker that stays clear as projects and stories grow

Timetoast helps you organize the details behind a project, lesson, or story and turn them into a
timeline that is easier to scan, explain, and share.

[Screenshot of a horizontal timeline with color-coded events laid out automatically.]
See the big picture at a glance

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is Timetoast?

Timetoast is an online timeline maker that helps you turn plans, projects, and stories into clear
interactive timelines. It combines a flexible workspace with synced timeline views so you can
organize details and present them clearly.

### Who is Timetoast for?

Timetoast is for teams and individuals who need to show how work or events unfold over time. People
use it for project plans, product roadmaps, campaigns, lessons, biographies, legal timelines, and
historical overviews.

### Can I use Timetoast for project planning and roadmaps?

Yes. Timetoast works well for project timelines, product roadmaps, launches, and other plans that
need a clear visual schedule. You can map milestones, group related work, and share updates without
adopting a full project management suite.

### How do the different timeline views work?

You can switch between horizontal, vertical, and grid views for the same timeline. Each view stays
in sync, so you can plan, review, and update the same timeline from different perspectives. The grid
is especially useful for fast filtering, sorting, and structured edits.

### Can I collaborate with others or share timelines with clients?

Yes. You can invite teammates and groups, control whether people can view, edit, or publish, and
keep work private until it is ready to share more broadly.

### Can I use Timetoast for history, biographies, or education?

Yes. Timetoast is also used for classroom lessons, historical timelines, biography projects, and
other stories that need clear chronological context. Flexible date handling and multiple views help
those timelines stay accurate and easy to read.

### How do sharing and privacy work?

Your timelines are private by default. When you are ready, you can share them with selected
collaborators, publish them publicly, or embed them on a website or intranet.

### What makes Timetoast different from other timeline tools?

Timetoast combines a flexible workspace with synced timeline views, so you can manage details in one
place and present them as horizontal, vertical, or grid timelines. It also supports custom fields,
color coding, lane grouping, BCE dates, timespans, and flexible sharing controls, which makes it
useful for a wider range of projects than most simple timeline makers.

### How much does Timetoast cost?

You can start with Timetoast using the Starter plan, and paid plans add more capacity, collaboration
options, and features for teams or client-facing work.

# *Veranex: *The Innovation CRO That Accelerates What’s Next

#### As the industry’s first Innovation CRO, Veranex unites design, preclinical, clinical,
#### regulatory, and market access under one roof to accelerate your next‑gen devices.

[ The iCRO Difference ][309]

[slash-1]

### Veranex: The Integrated, Patient-Centric Innovation CRO

Traditional CROs and boutique vendors fragment device and diagnostic development with multiple
hand-offs, blind spots, and learning curves thereby increasing the likelihood for costly delays and
missed goals.

**Veranex unites **product design, engineering, manufacturing, preclinical, clinical, regulatory,
quality and market-access expertise under one Innovation CRO (iCRO) roof. Every decision is informed
and connected with cross-disciplinary experts. **The result**: proven speed and delivery,
crystal-clear accountability, innovative next-generation devices and diagnostics that produce
life-changing patient benefits at a global scale.

### Our Services

Vita Global Sciences’ comprehensive suite of offerings includes clinical data management,
cutting-edge technology solutions, and robust compliance support encompassing quality assurance,
validation processes, and regulatory guidance. Additionally, we offer expert clinical operations
management to ensure efficient trial execution. With a deep understanding of the complexities of
clinical development, we are committed to delivering tailor-made solutions that drive progress and
accelerate the path to market for innovative therapeutics.

Clinical Ops

Clinical IT Services

Clinical Ops

Effective Clinical Operations are the cornerstone of successful drug development. Our dedicated team
of professionals is attuned to the critical nuances that drive clinical trial success, from
meticulous protocol adherence to proactive risk management. We prioritize precision and compliance
at every stage, ensuring your trials proceed with maximum efficiency and regulatory confidence.
[ Learn More [Arrow-Blue-Off] ][42]

Clinical Data Management

At Vita Global Sciences, we understand that the importance of clinical data assets in
pharmaceutical, biotech and medical device industry. Our expert team is committed to ensuring that
your clinical trial data management process: 1) fits your project needs, 2) is highly efficient, and
3) meets the highest standards of integrity and quality by complying with Good Clinical Data
Management Practices (GCDMP) and Clinical Data Interchange Standards Consortium (CDSIC)
requirements. A team of highly experienced data managers will support all CDM-aspects of our
project, individual trial databases are developed according to your business requirements, data is
being consequently monitored and validated prior to transfer to the formulation level.


Our core competencies in data management comes from our thorough knowledge of standards, our
flexible systems, and the effective use of vividly available data management systems.

[ Learn More [Arrow-Blue-Off] ][43]

Biostatistics

Vita Global Sciences has developed a network of statisticians who are at the cutting-edge of advance
statistical design and analysis, with in-depth expertise across therapeutic areas. Irrespective of
where you are in the product development lifecycle and approval process, Vita Global Sciences can
provide you with the strategic consulting needed in performing/optimizing the trial design and
developing a statistical analysis plan which will detail the safety and efficacy analysis methods
required for securing marketing approval. We also have ample experience in representing the customer
at regulatory body meetings. Our Biostatistics team offers services on complex statistical issues
encountered during study design or analysis. They bring expertise and insights in trial design,
sample size calculations, randomization, interim analyses, developing complex statistical analysis
plans (SAPs), and consulting on adaptive design. They have extensive experience in interacting with
FDA and are actively collaborating with academia, industry and FDA working groups.
[ Learn More [Arrow-Blue-Off] ][44]

Statistical Programming

Vita Global Sciences has expert programmers in the areas of SAS, R, and Python who tactfully and
efficiently handle clinical trial data to provide automated outputs in accordance with industry and
regulatory standards. Our team quickly adapts client specific technologies and best practices and
provides insightful analysis and clinical study reports that empowers clients to draw
interpretations and make well-informed decisions. A clearly laid out QC procedure helps us to
deliver results on time, and with utmost quality.
[ Learn More [Arrow-Blue-Off] ][45]

### Designed for measurable impact

Performance metrics are based on internal benchmark analyses, client feedback, and case study data,

Tabulation Model (SDTM) mapping), and accelerated database lock in a complex Phase III study.
Results may vary depending on study design and implementation scope.

## Trusted by research teams across the clinical ecosystem

A scalable, end‑to‑end solution that supports fast‑growing teams by reducing manual processes and

Integrated workflows for device trials and software as a medical device (SaMD) with full regulatory

> challenged the underlying assumptions to ensure the study's goals and objectives were clearly
> defined and the operating structure matched with the study's intent. Their system is not a

> requirements into a system that merges health information/data and can then become not only

> Wemedoo's cross-functional, integrated teams capture EDC set-up, go-live, data capture, data

> experience industry benchmark whilst keeping these data solutions lean and affordable. Besides the
> great proprietary systems they use, their integrated team approach with personal responsibility
> and honest commitment to targeting outcomes differentiates the Wemedoo team from other providers.
> Wemedoo only made Oxular's key initial trial, a device-drug trial possible, as based on some
> pre-work, the Wemedoo team could substantially adapt and update the first EDC ideas for a trial
> under a US FDA IND. The Wemedoo team worked extremely focused on familiarizing US trial sites and
> clinical CROs with the use of their system, which turned out to be a key success factor of the
> respective trial. The highly professional and up-to-date capabilities in data sciences were
> mirrored by customer-centricity and super fast timelines of integrating mandatory adaptations to
> the data systems.

Friedrich Asmus

Former Chief Medical Officer at OXULAR

> All jobs, both large and small, are performed with the same dedication to quality, detail,

Volodymyr Stus, MD

Biopharmaceutics and Clinical Research Department Manager at Polpharma SA

> Complex adaptive trials demand speed, precision, and system stability. With oomnia, Wemedoo's

# Better wikis
# For everyone

[Start Building][6]
[ [Wikiful - Pain-free wikis for individuals and teams. | Product Hunt Embed] ][7]

## What:

Now you can build, edit, and share wikis from anywhere.

### For Teams

Snappy, crisp wikis for nimble teams.
  No enterprise bulk + an editor with
serious horsepower.
[Team Demo][8]

### For Teachers

Organize, save, and share
your lessons / notes / curriculum.
  Easy to use, no IT wizardry required.
[Teacher Demo][9]

### For Entrepreneurs

Goodbye crowded workspaces.
  Fast, powerful, and intuitive for both
technical and non-technical founders.
[Entrepreneur Demo][10]

### For Travelers

No more email digging and
last-second searching.  All the info,
in one place, before you leave.
[Traveler Demo][11]

### For Experts

Structure your expertise, and
reference or share it in a snap.
  Organization + collaboration.
[Expert Demo][12]
Teams Teachers Entrepreneurs Travelers Experts

## Why:

You’re getting by, but there’s a better option.
Here's how Wikiful can fix your problem.

### My team's using an annoying tool.

#### My team doesn't like the wiki / documentation platform we currently use.  It's clunky, slow,
#### and painful.

Wikiful ditched the dead weight that makes using
enterprise wikis a chore.  No more crowded workspace. 
Edit-in-place without a reload.  Runs 10x faster than
That Ubiquitous Enterprise Wiki Product.

#### Every time I need to repeat something that I've already done, I have to reinvent the wheel.

Wikiful makes it easy to create documentation for your work and your life.  That way you never have
to waste mental energy figuring out what you've already figured out — whether that's setting up AWS,
cooking a recipe, or
teaching a new semester.

### I’m wasting and repeating efforts.

### Sharing is hard.

#### When people ask me to share things, it's tough to get it to them.  And to keep track of who
#### sees what.

Share with a click, and loop in collaborators seamlessly.  Wikiful makes it easy to grant as much —
or as little — access to your wiki as you want.  Keeping track of who can view and collaborate on
your content is a breeze.

[Sign Up][13] [Interactive Demo][14]

## How Much:

Grab a plan that fits your needs.  Switch anytime.

### Free Plan

$0
/month
1 wiki
Unlimited pages
Up to 5 collaborators
[Sign up][15]

### Advanced Plan

$10
/month
One month free trial
Unlimited wikis & pages
Up to 10 collaborators
[Sign up][16]

### Business Plan

$10
/month for 10 users
+$5 per additional user
One month free trial
Unlimited wikis & pages
Grows with your team
[Sign up][17]

## FAQ:

### Why do I need a wiki?

For info that you need to access often, keep up-to-date, share, or collaborate on, a wiki performs
better than alternative tools.  Wikis are a great solution when people get frustrated that notes are
too scattered, documents lack organization, and digging through emails is a pain.

Check out our demos for examples of how wikis are great for [retaining institutional knowledge][18],
[tracking personal information][19], [organizing creative projects][20], and [beyond][21].

### Will my wikis be secure and private?

Yes and yes — you have complete control over who can view and collaborate on your wikis.

Got a recipe wiki that you want to share widely?  Make it public for anyone to view. 
Created a wiki for an upcoming trip?  Only grant access to the folks traveling with you. 
Outlining your plans for the Great American Novel?  Keep the wiki private and for-your-eyes-only. 
You can make each wiki as public or as private as you want.

### Can I change plans later?

Yes.  You can upgrade or downgrade your account at any time.

### What happens to my content if I cancel my account?

We hope that you'll love Wikiful and will want to keep your wikis alive and thriving. 
But if you decide to close your account, you can use the "Export Wiki" feature to save a copy
of your wiki's content to your computer.

# Welcome To WJPR!                                                                                  
                                                                                                    
**WJPR** is a worldwide multidisciplinary, monthly published, open access, peer-reviewed, online    
pharmacy journal. The aim of WJPR is to serve as a means for updating the scientific knowledge of   
the international audience in the pharmaceutical forum.                                             
                                                                                                    
The Journal welcomes the original research articles, review, short communications and case studies  
relevant to the various fields of Pharmaceutical Sciences such as; Pharmaceutics, Pharmaceutical    
Technology, Biopharmaceutics, Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Analysis and Quality         
Assurance, Medicinal Chemistry, Pharmacology and Toxicology, Pharmacy Practice includes Hospital    
Community and Clinical Pharmacy, Pharmacognosy and Phytochemistry, Pharmaceutical Microbiology and  
Biotechnology, Regulatory Affairs and Pharmaceutical Marketing Research, and Alternative Medicines. 
                                                                                                    
##### Journal Standards                                                                             
* A broad ranging open access online journal.                                                       
* Eminent editorials from thought out the world.                                                    
* Fast online manuscript submission.                                                                
* Rapid publication high visibility.                                                                
* Our journal indexed in different reputed publisher databases.                                     
* Gives Email/SMS alert updates.                                                                    
                                                                                                    
The Journal particularly aims to foster the dissemination of scientific information by publishing   
manuscripts related to current Pharmaceutical Drug Delivery and related fields. We started with a   
Mission to encourage contribution to Research in Sciences & Technology for achieving better future  
lives for all. We serve Science & Mankind at the highest levels of Professional Ethical Conduct.
